_readme: S636 SkyAntennae, 2026-11-11. Redwoods' 2026-2027 CRGE pattern sheet prints 'CRGE Units Required 21', 'Major Requirements and Elective Units 18+' and 'Minimum Degree Units for Associate 60' (read 43013608134, redwoods_crge_sheet.json; COBIx's finding on #3096, verified). A reconcile step keys on the program page's own words, so this read asks four local degree pages what they print about general education, electives and the degree's total: Personal Wellness A.S. 44463, Forestry and Natural Resources Technology A.S. 01796, Registered Nursing A.S. 01831 (78-81 printed), Liberal Arts: Business A.A. 18231. No model call.
